about: Template tagging over backend/templates/*.tex. 'required' lists groups: at least one tag of each group must be chosen. 'forbidden' tags clearly do not fit. Tags in neither list are fine either way. Inline cases (with a 'latex' field) are short CVs outside tech, so a constant answer such as 'Technology, Engineering' cannot pass most cases.
